proposed.text: What is the primary output of Architectural Programming as a pre-design service under SPP 201?

options.text: A schematic design concept, which serves as an initial visual representation of the project's architectural intent
A project feasibility report, detailing the economic, technical, and operational viability of the proposed project
A design brief for bidding, outlining the project's scope, budget, and timeline for potential contractors

rationale.a: Schematic design is part of SPP 202 Regular Design Services, not a pre-design output.
rationale.b: A feasibility report is the output of a feasibility study, a separate pre-design service.
rationale.c: Correct. Architectural Programming produces a Program of Requirements (POR) that defines the functional, spatial, and performance requirements of the project.
rationale.d: A design brief for bidding is the output of Design Brief Preparation, a different pre-design service.
rationale.correct: Architectural Programming under SPP 201 produces a Program of Requirements (POR). The POR systematically defines the project's functional needs, spatial requirements, adjacencies, and performance criteria — serving as the foundation for design.
rationale.takeaway: Architectural Programming output = Program of Requirements (POR).
